about: Desktop band (1280x800, mouse, no touch). The page is scrolled so the first face of the people 'o' sits 250 px below the viewport top, left idle until the row has opened (1420 ms of virtual time), then a synthetic mouseover on that face opens the seller preview (the stand-in for a pointer, which the headless run does not have); after 60 idle frames (1 s: the probe of run 39881189724 shows the face x constant, 516, in all 40 scroll frames) the page scrolls 3 CSS px per frame for 40 frames (120 px: the card closes when the heading is less than 35% visible, about 215 px of scroll from this start) with the card open (programmatic scrollTo, as swipe-v1). The recorded question is the Layout count per frame of the 'scroll' phase: people.o:preview-translate writes left/top once and sets translate per frame, the base writes top every frame. Premise (task chromium-desktop-crash): the page runs with text-wrap: wrap on every element, as profile desktop-1280, because text-wrap: balance on the people card title crashes the renderer of Chrome 156.0.8078.4; the counts are those of the page without text balancing. After the counted pass, the plan is replayed once with a PNG hash and the rect of the open card per frame (the probe, not counted).

segments.name: hover
segments.eval: document.querySelector('[data-selenium^="start-selling.people.button.preview."]').dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseover', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, view: window }));
